Landslides and heavy rainfall cause disruptions across India

Heavy rainfall and landslides have led to significant disruptions across various parts of India, including Kerala, Maharashtra, and Jammu and Kashmir. Incidents have resulted in fatalities, missing persons, and blocked transportation routes, prompting rescue and clearance operations. The events highlight the impact of severe weather on infrastructure and public safety.
